headline: Executive order sets the order in which Interior Department officials would step in to lead if the Secretary cannot serve.
what_it_does: This order lists which officials at the Department of the Interior would act as Secretary if the Secretary and other top leaders die, resign, or are unable to do the job. Its purpose is to keep the department running without a gap in leadership. No summary was provided, so the exact list of officials and any conditions are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Senior Department of the Interior officials
who_it_affects.how: Certain officials are named, in a set order, to temporarily carry out the Secretary's duties if needed.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed December 18, 2001; specific effective date not stated in the available information.
